title: Equipment Follow-Up Visits for Homebound Patients (Referrals and Authorizations)
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when the cancellation of an approved authorization is confirmed, an equipment follow-up is held for authorization types that require the patient to be homebound (the Home Health Care Authorization), so the provider can close out training on newly placed equipment.

## Source record

The patient's most recently delivered item in rental under **Durable Medical Equipment Rentals**: among the patient's placed items whose status is in rental, the one with the latest delivery date, with its payment class and delivery date.

## Terms (types that require the patient to be homebound)

1. Where that item is Capped Rental Equipment or a Power Mobility Device delivered no more than thirty days ago, **2 visits** are held.
2. Where it is another kind of item delivered no more than thirty days ago, **1 visit** is held.
3. Otherwise nothing is held.

For a type that does not require the patient to be homebound, nothing is held under this rule.

## Examples (hypothetical, Home Health Care Authorization)

| Most recently delivered item in rental | Delivered | Visits held |
|---|---|---|
| Capped Rental Equipment | 30 days ago | 2 |
| Capped Rental Equipment | 31 days ago | 0 |
| Continuous Positive Airway Pressure Equipment | 10 days ago | 1 |
| none in rental | not applicable | 0 |
